title: The Instant team joins OpenAI
content:
We have a big announcement to make today: the Instant team is joining OpenAI.
We started Instant to make it easy for you to build delightful apps. Over the last few years we saw that most of our users began to use Instant through agents. Agents already empower many of us to build more ambitious things, and we’re only at the beginning stages of what they can do. We are excited to join OpenAI and bring intelligence to as many people as we can.
If you are a user of Instant Cloud, this is what the news means for you:
- New signups are closed. Existing users should migrate off of Instant Cloud within the next 12 months. Any subscriptions that were started after July 31st, 2026 will be fully refunded.
- On August 31st, 2027, all cloud apps will shut down. Backups will stay available for 12 more months, until August 31st, 2028.
- We’ve written a guide to help you self-host Instant and migrate your apps too. All of Instant is open source, and we’ve worked to make the migration process as seamless as possible.
The idea behind Instant started in 2021. We shared a 
blog post
 about a database in the browser. It was only an idea, but the more apps we built, the more we saw the need for it. We joined YC in 2022, built a prototype, and 
shared
 a version zero.
Turning a prototype into something production-grade was a long journey. The work was hard, but there were many moments of joy. 
[1]
 Very early on Daniel joined the team and helped solve some of the gnarliest problems in sync tech. Our community grew, more folks joined 
[2]
, and we officially 
open sourced
. From there it was a maelstrom of feedback and making Instant better. When time came to really make our TypeScript SDKs ergonomic, Drew joined the team and did just that. From there, over 17,000 users got to try Instant. They made 400,000 apps, and those apps processed about 2.5 billion transactions.
If you are an Instant customer, it’s been an honor building for you.
(Right to left) Joe Averbukh, Stepan Parunashvili, Daniel Woelfel, Drew Harris

report.summary: Instant团队加入OpenAI，Instant Cloud将关停并推动用户自托管迁移。
report.background: Instant始于2021年关于浏览器内数据库的构想，2022年进入YC孵化并推出原型，后正式开源。产品吸引了超1.7万用户，创建约40万个应用，处理25亿笔交易。团队发现大部分用户已通过AI智能体使用Instant，这成为加入OpenAI的关键动因。如今Instant Cloud新注册关闭，现有服务将在2027年8月关停，但全栈代码保持开源并提供自托管迁移指南。
key_points: Instant团队全员加入OpenAI，Cloud新用户注册停止，现有云用户需在12个月内迁移离开。
关闭时间表明确：所有云应用2027年8月31日关停，备份数据保留至2028年8月31日。
2026年7月31日后启动的订阅将全额退款，老订阅用户需按官方指南自行迁移。
Instant是开源产品，1.7万用户创建40万个应用，处理约25亿笔交易，迁移路径相对平滑。
联合创始人透露，多数用户已通过智能体使用Instant，新团队将把智能能力带给更多人。
report.impact: 对AI行业而言，这是AI实验室收购并整合数据/应用层基础设施的又一案例，可能加速“智能体优先”的云服务形态。对开发者来说，依赖初创SaaS需警惕关停风险，但Instant全面开源与迁移指南降低锁定成本。对普通用户而言，云服务关停带来一定不便，但有空窗期和备份保障，可平稳过渡到自托管或替代方案。
report.tools: 可关注Instant官方GitHub仓库（instantdb/instant）和其自托管迁移指南；若需要AI辅助迁移，可结合OpenAI Codex或ChatGPT自动改写代码与配置。
